final: SELECT t.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS n_transactions, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT tr.transreg)) OVER () AS proportion FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind
